content.text:
Fixed in `lib/request.js:48`.

**Cause.** The GHSA-444r-cwp2-x5xf hardening in 5.8.3 (`4e1db5bd`) added an `a != null` guard to *every* branch of `getTrustProxyFn`, including the hop-count branch:

```js
return function (a, i) { return a != null && i < tp }
```

Hop-count trust is positional — it says "trust the first N addresses in the chain" — so the address value must not matter. Under iisnode (and any unix-socket/named-pipe deployment) IIS talks to Node over a pipe, so `req.socket.remoteAddress` is `undefined`. `@fastify/forwarded` puts that `undefined` at index 0 of the address list, the guard declared it untrusted, and `proxyAddr.all` truncated the list to `[undefined]` — hence `req.ip === undefined`, and `req.host`/`req.protocol` also stopped honoring `x-forwarded-host`/`-proto`.

**Change.** Dropped the `a != null` guard from the numeric branch only, with a comment explaining why. The string/array/compiled-IP branches keep it — there the trust decision genuinely depends on the peer address, so a missing address must stay untrusted, and the security fix is preserved (the existing "ignores forwarded headers from untrusted connections" test still passes).

Reproduced the bug first on a unix socket (`ip: undefined | ips: [ undefined ]`), and after the fix: `ip: 1.2.3.4 | host: proxied.example.com | protocol: https`. Added a regression test, `trust proxy number without a socket address`, in `test/trust-proxy.test.js` (skipped on win32) that listens on a unix socket and asserts `ip`, `host`, `hostname` and `protocol`. `test/trust-proxy.test.js` (9/9), `test/request-port.test.js`, `test/internals/request.test.js` and `test/request-error.test.js` all pass; I could not run `npm run lint` — the command needs approval — so the new test's style is matched by hand against the surrounding file.

Per COMPLEX.md, co-change partner `lib/reply.js` needed no change: it has no references to trustProxy, `proxyAddr`, `remoteAddress` or `request.ip`, and the shared `kRequestSignal`/`kOnAbort` symbols are untouched. Nothing committed.
